windows.default: Original wooden windows mounted on plaster.
windows.border_width: Same source posts and wooden side strips as the doors
windows.assembly: Full border + detail = framed transparent window. For wall-mounted windows use a matching integrated module or mount_frame + glass_overlay. Empty and lattice mounts provide the opening mask.
windows.source: The window surround copies the actual door frame; the bottom sill is from the window reference.

revision: Only original plaster and timber elements retained. Other wall families and proposed opening material variations discarded.
